description:
Luciane Buchanan, Hunter Doohan, Souheila Yacoub, and director Sébastien Vaniček sit down with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Perri Nemiroff to talk about their upcoming gritty horror flick, ‘Evil Dead Burn’. Director Sébastien Vaniček describes how his ‘Evil Dead’ mentors taught him to fight for his ideas and choices as a new director to Hollywood, Luciane Buchanan describes her technique for going full “deadite”, and they laugh about the complicated, frenetic action sequences and what it was like to shoot them on the day!  ‘Evil Dead Burn’ hits theaters July 10!
